name: document-conventions
title_zh: 文档归档三问才出手：补、纠、废，不碰日常生成
tagline_zh: 只在你要补文档、纠错、废弃或质疑 .docs 结构时才现身。日常写文件它不打扰——规则管日常，它管例外，分工干净。
tagline_en: Appears only when you ask to fix, retire, or question .docs/ naming—or set it up fresh. Routine file writes? It.
desc_en: Document archival convention setup and reference. Triggers ONLY when: (1) the user asks how to supplement/correct/deprecate a document, (2) the user questions .docs/ naming or structure, (3) first-time setup of .docs/ in a new workspace. Do NOT trigger on routine document generation — the Rule handles day-to-day enforcement.
why_zh: 触发边界刻得极窄，把「归档约定」和「日常执行」拆成两层。它只回答例外怎么走，不抢规则引擎的活。
why_en: Surgical trigger scope splits archival policy from daily execution. Handles exceptions without shadowing the rule engine—no.
limit_zh: 只认三种动作：补充、更正、废弃文档，或首次搭建 .docs/。日常写新文件。
limit_en: Only fires on supplement/correct/deprecate requests or first .docs/ setup. Routine doc generation is ignored—that's the Rule's job. Other archive.
title_en: Archive conventions: only for supplement, correct.
